label: bug
file: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The issue describes a discrepancy in the timing of the Monday summary email, where users in Sydney receive it on Tuesday instead of Monday. The logic in `rollup.ts` uses `localHour` and `startOfWeek` to determine when to send the email, but the problem may lie in how the time zone offset or day calculation interacts with the scheduling logic. The reporter confirms time zones are correctly set, so the bug likely stems from the `isRollupDue` function or the scheduling mechanism not accounting for time zone transitions or edge cases in day boundaries.
